text: かてる　じしんが　あるなら　タケシと　たたかって　みなよ！

structure.jp: かてる　じしんが　あるなら
structure.en: if you have the confidence that you can win

structure.jp: タケシと　たたかって　みなよ！

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: てみる after a verb means 'try doing it and see'. みな is short for みなさい, a light order. たたかって　みな = 'go on, try battling'.

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.explanation: なら means 'if that is the case'. じしんが　あるなら = 'if you have the confidence'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing かつ to かてる adds 'can'. It sits before じしん to say what the confidence is about. かてる　じしん = 'confidence that you can win'.
